verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no self-service, cross-merchant product search API that a user's own agent can call. Store Sync's agent discovery is a merchant-side program that requires a form submission and onboarding by the PayPal AI team, and it surfaces products through partner platforms such as ChatGPT and Google AI Mode. The toolkit's list_product and show_product_details tools only read the developer's own PayPal catalog, which is an adjacent feature rather than cross-merchant search.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can programmatically search products or services across merchants — keylessly or with self-service credentials, no private partnership required
